A shopper should not walk around the store while carrying an item by hand.
After any item has been collected using the cart, the cart must eventually be returned to the northwest return point.
A cart may be put down only at the designated northwest cart-return cell.
A shopper is not allowed to leave the supermarket while still holding or pushing the cart.
Once the cart has been returned, the shopper should not perform further object interactions before exiting.
After returning the cart, the shopper should proceed toward the exit without moving north or west.
